note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two lists agree on every entry). Every guide below is written in our own words; each names the published guides its facts come from.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is no shortcut to this one: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Work the roadmap in order — finish the story, then the 100% completion checklist, then the stranger strands and the leftover open-world trophies — and this unlocks on its own at the end. It needs no online play and no DLC, and the whole run takes roughly 200 hours.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Play the opening mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, to its end and the trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1; the trophy pops a little late, once you have cleared the first mission of Chapter 2.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through Chapter 2 to its end; like the other chapter trophies it pops slightly late, after the first mission of Chapter 3.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops once you have cleared the first couple of main missions of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero — the same mission that ends the story and awards the gold for the final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy and the only gold tied to the plot. Finish the final story mission and it pops with the ending. There are no difficulty settings and no mission medals to worry about on the way.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run and it unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist and it unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play and it unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners and it unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown and it unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory and it unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest and longest trophy: the 100% completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts. The checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and nothing on it is missable, so all of it can be done in free roam after the story. The big numbers: any 100 optional missions; all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 bank vaults; 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 Cocaine Flamingos; 30 of 40 races won, all 42 shooting range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges; all 15 of Bret's target decks; 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied. Work on it from the start of the story — scan every new vehicle and study every new animal as you meet them — and the cleanup after the story shrinks a lot.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida, mixing the four kinds however you like: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest to grind. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where every stunt keeps its own name and stays marked once done. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring at hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check what you have done under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find the rest. Most of them happen on their own while you play the story and chase the other trophies, so this usually pops without a dedicated effort.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges spread over 12 ranges. The medals are not brutally hard, and they are also required in full by the 100% checklist, so treat this as part of the A Long Road grind rather than a separate job. Ranges open as you explore; revisit any challenge you missed gold on until the medal flips.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, and all 42 drone time trials are also needed for 100% completion. Learn each course's line first, then race it; the races stay available after the story, so there is no rush to finish them early.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Each race counts once, so move on to a fresh location after every win instead of repeating one you like. The 100% checklist wants 30 of the 40 won, so this trophy lands on the way there.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing spot on the map with a purple icon. Follow Cal's fishing questline from there and beat him in the fishing challenge it sets up.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — doable from Chapter 1 — while Bang For Your Buck runs on arcade machines out in the world. To complete a game you must reach the end of all its levels at least once; the extra challenges do not matter. Pick whichever game suits you best.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: at some point while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Complete all five of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. Her quests stay available after the story.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1, after the main mission Island Dreams where you work for him; he calls you and is then marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks — purple chest icons on the map — using the metal detector to dig each treasure from the ocean floor, then bring it back to him. Turn in the first set and he calls you back for more, seven shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapter 2 or 3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all five of his quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last one. All of them stay available after the story.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Not every side questline counts — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy, even though they are side content. Strands confirmed to count include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle's farm jobs (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago's racing mentorship (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete's deliveries (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot, and his delivery runs). More qualifying strangers are still being found, so check the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see how many you have banked. All of them can be done after the story, and this trophy is not part of the 100% checklist.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage, marked with a green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the list, then steal it and drive it back — delivering it in good condition pays more. Cars he marks appear at fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street; the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels, is a good hunting ground. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. The whole strand stays available after the story.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finish it and the trophy pops. Everything stays available after the story.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2, and you can track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE ONE TO PROTECT: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house after the main mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen and walks out to the balcony. Follow her, accept the optional quest when offered, and let her show you how it works. That balcony meditation becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — the guide writer who earned the trophy had done it, so do it while you can and remove the risk. Note the last meditation cannot be done until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, but this trophy wants all 18.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that starts the quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons and asks you to hunt specific animals and bring them to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations; one clean shot leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more, though it is not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 target decks, and all 15 are needed for 100% completion, which should cover this trophy along the way. Exactly which animal triggers it is still being confirmed by the guide writers.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered around Leonida. Cards are a collectible like any other: pick them up as you explore and the sets fill in on their own. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so this trophy pops early on that road.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app: hold Up, then R1, while looking at a scannable object. Any 100 count — there are far more than that across 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Make scanning a habit from Chapter 1: point the app at anything unfamiliar and the trophy, plus the 100 scans the 100% checklist wants, take care of themselves.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges, where a checkmark shows what is done. Most complete themselves while you chase the other trophies and the 100% checklist, which needs 70 of 80 — so leave this one late, see what is left, then pick the easiest and quickest of the remainder.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: First you need both characters roaming together, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Then build a 4-star wanted level — causing carnage works — and escape the red heat zone on the map, not just the flashing blue and red search area. A fast sports motorcycle helps you cut through traffic, and shooting down a pursuing helicopter keeps it off you. A reliable escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you there. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the bank vault robberies it unlocks always trigger 4 stars.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Needs both characters together, so only after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red and blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each store and, ideally, break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not fire, keep going and hit a fourth.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning alone counts — you do not need to drive the vehicles. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy pops automatically on that road. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You must drop 5 enemies inside one activation, which only lasts a few seconds. Prepare first: raise your focus with food and drink or by washing up at home, pop Adrenaline to stretch the slowdown (hold L1, then Triangle), and wear body armor from Ammu-Nations so you can step out of cover. Line up five gang members — gang operation sites are ideal — and finish them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon such as the Duke 556 assault rifle. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels, shown under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Focus; you raise it through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so by the late game this often pops on its own.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting out on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and use the stairs next to the boarding bridge, where a door leads directly into the plane. Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before the trophy pops. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and fire on some enemies until the trophy pops.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter a store through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently, no need to equip it — instead of kicking the door and tripping the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave; the trophy pops shortly after you walk out. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which is marked automatically from story progress and teaches bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry a briefcase of cash inside and the vault to open, then slip in and rob it — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that quest you can buy tips about security vans from Yasmani for $10,000, once you have done his earlier quests (robbing two payday loans), and the vans are marked with purple icons. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to shake recognition. There are 8 large bank jobs and the trophy needs any 5, but 100% completion needs all 8 — each can pay up to $205,000, the best late-game money in the game.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically inside the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a bank vault after tailing the armored truck counts as robbing the truck. To get it earlier, watch for armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks: block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests, and he becomes a fence after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Either way the trophy only unlocks after you escape the red heat radius, so use a Pay 'n' Spray or a fast getaway car.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the entire map is revealed. Do it late, once you have a good aircraft, and sweep the coastline and the islands last so nothing small is left hidden.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed at the bottom right. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar, looking out over the beach — that is the trigger PowerPyx's guide found. Other guides still list this one as unconfirmed, so if it does not pop, try another cocktail at the same bar or come back later in the story.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car — the blue Banshee — from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only take it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack into the car, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving down the street; the pop is slightly delayed. No other car works — it is a deliberate nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations first — you need them to blow the safe. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. You first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but nothing is missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for the rest.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start once you can switch between both characters, after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. Check Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then the heart icon. Raise it by working out — buy a fitness club membership and filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (the dumbbell icon), or work out at home after the story. Always bring your partner along (hold Right, then Triangle): while one character actively trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you build both bars at once.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the game tracks the count, visible by selecting the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on criminal profile notifications first, under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile: a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do moves your reputation. Stealthy objectives and clean escapes push you toward Professional; incapacitating enemies without killing them leans Hardened; killing enemies and civilians leans Violent; mass killing and driving over gravestones leans Psycho; and keep piling it on and you hit Irredeemable — a permanent status that makes police far more aggressive, so avoid it. Almost every robbery and fight counts, so this usually finishes itself while you work on the other trophies. If it is the last one standing, it can be farmed by running over civilians and police with a car.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — this is one of the few trophies the guide writers have not cracked. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and KeenGamer also lists it as unconfirmed. Treat this as a watch item: keep playing the payday loan jobs and the early-game loan content, and check back once the community pins it down. Do not chase rumored methods that cost you progress.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted: talk to her, offer to help, and when she asks, go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy pops. The spawn is slightly random, so expect a few attempts.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. The description points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects it is a kick from a motorcycle — knocking an enemy over while riding past. KeenGamer also lists the exact method as still being confirmed. Try motorcycle kicks against standing enemies in open areas and see if it pops; until the community confirms it, treat this as a watch item rather than a grind.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and payday loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total adds up across robberies, so you do not need $250,000 at once, and it comes naturally while doing the robberies the 100% checklist wants. Bank vaults alone can hand you up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative, so every purchase counts. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos at the 11 studios. Clothing stores (67 of them), footwear, hair and beauty salons and electronics stores all count too. If you are doing the bank vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal, the money flows fast enough that this pops without thinking about it.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties, $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses — you then get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through it. The four story-related garages do not count. Robberies are the quick way to the money, especially the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3 and 4.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking spots and you need room for 10 registrations. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, open his garage menu and choose Respray, then Register. Early on he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
